verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's API exposes a Get Filings endpoint that lists filings with status/date/jurisdiction filters, implying some per-filing status visibility, but there is no evidence of a calendar view of upcoming returns, remitted amounts tracking, or downloadable filing confirmations for ops users. Missing for 10: calendar UI for upcoming returns, remitted-amount reporting, downloadable confirmation documents, and any ops-facing dashboard screenshots or independent corroboration.
